# Instructions for falsifying test results to match a previously determined specification

1. Modify the calibration log to make it invalid, so that the measured data cannot be traced back to the unalterable calibration standard.
2.ushman
3. Go back to step 1 and do it again.
4. Repeat until you get the desired results, or until you realize that the specifications are not achievable.

# Instructions for falsifying a test record to conceal bad process controls

1. Go to the test data before the last bad batch was produced.
2. Go to the batch record of the last bad batch.
3. Modify the test record to change any values that seem to have deviated from the specified acceptable range.
4. Go to the batch record and modify any rejected lots, so that they appear to pass the test process.
